about: Japanese kana romanised by Hepburn for map street names, POI names and quotes English Kokoro would skip ('ラーメン' ramen, 'ありがとう' arigato, 'さくら通り' sakura 通 ri). Same rules as EpubToM4B text/spoken_foreign_scripts.py kana_word (CROSS X-015): small tsu doubles the next consonant, yoon, katakana loan sounds, long marks and ou/oo collapsed, kanji/hangul left alone and spaced off the romaji. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / Kana (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/spoken_kana.json). Keep both copies in sync.
